title: Finders Keepers
overview: A young women becomes a tenant in an inner city property and takes pity on a girl who has fallen on hard times, giving her a place to stay. Decorating their new home together, they discover a stash of money hidden in one of the walls. Their lucky feeling soon turns to unlucky as they learn that their exciting discovery comes at a price - some very bad people want their money back and will stop at nothing to get it.
